objectives.description: Re-run literature-briefing.sh, assert clean stderr, and assert per-document title + Relevance line for every new entry
objectives.note: First pass caught a real defect: venema_2001_sec04 rendered its title but no Relevance line, because Phase 4 had appended a duplicate doc_id entry rather than checking whether it was already registered (it was, under task 408). Fixed by merging into the pre-existing entry (see Phase 4 correction) and removing the duplicate. Second pass: stderr clean, all 8 target documents (7 new + merged venema_2001_sec04) render title and Relevance line.

objectives.description: Assert seg_count arithmetic and record sparse=false as non-diagnostic
objectives.note: seg_count=40 = 33 baseline + 7 genuinely-new documents (not 8 -- venema_2001_sec04 was already registered). sparse=false on both passes, consistent with F3's finding that this metric cannot fail here.

objectives.description: Run short AND-safe literature-search.sh queries and confirm reachability
objectives.note: 'mosaic' -> caleiro_2013 top hit. 'closure'/'elementary sets' -> baier_katoen_2008 (bare parent doc_id, matching F6's finding that the FTS5 index does not distinguish parts) -- confirms the closure-set material is reachable via search despite the part-level id/FTS mismatch.

objectives.description: Record the F2 follow-up defect status and correct the plan/Testing & Validation section for the venema_2001_sec04 fix
objectives.note: 32 of 33 pre-existing entries remain relevance-less by design (Non-Goal); venema_2001_sec04 is the one exception, an incidental consequence of the duplicate-doc_id fix rather than a deliberate corpus-wide backfill.
